decisions_log.decision: Used Tailwind zinc-600/zinc-400 for muted text and zinc-950/zinc-50 for the link, matching the existing page.tsx palette, rather than introducing new design tokens.
decisions_log.rationale: page.tsx already uses these zinc shades; reusing them keeps the footer visually consistent without new token definitions.

decisions_log.decision: Chose border-black/[.08] dark:border-white/[.145] for the top separator, mirroring the opacity-based border used on the Documentation button in page.tsx.
decisions_log.rationale: Maintains visual consistency with existing site border style.

decisions_log.decision: Set up Jest + React Testing Library rather than Vitest because next/jest is the officially documented testing path for Next.js and was already available in the installed Next.js package.
decisions_log.rationale: No test framework existed; next/jest requires the least configuration for a Next.js app and is well-supported by the existing TypeScript setup.

files_changed.summary: New stateless Footer component rendering the current year and a GitHub repository link. Uses Tailwind CSS zinc and foreground/background tokens for light/dark theme compatibility. Link has target=_blank, rel=noopener noreferrer, and an aria-label.
Imports Footer and places <Footer /> at the bottom of the flex-column <body>, ensuring it appears on every page.
Jest configuration using next/jest transformer, jsdom test environment, and the @/... path alias.
Jest setup file that imports @testing-library/jest-dom to extend expect with DOM matchers.
RTL tests for Footer covering: current year rendered, GitHub link href, target=_blank + rel, aria-label accessibility, and footer landmark role.
Added test script and devDependencies: jest, jest-environment-jsdom, @testing-library/react, @testing-library/jest-dom, @types/jest.
Updated lock file to reflect new test devDependencies.

self_assessment.notes: AC2 and AC3 (light/dark visual legibility) are validated structurally by using established Tailwind dark: utilities from the same palette as page.tsx; they cannot be mechanically asserted in a jsdom test but are correctly wired at the CSS level. AC1 and AC4 have direct RTL assertions. All SWE constraints satisfied: existing Tailwind tokens used, target=_blank + rel=noopener noreferrer present, Footer placed at bottom of body in layout.tsx, components/ directory created.
